item.content:encoded:
SCP-5179 is a interdimensional anomaly located in ██████. The project can only be seen on the night of the new moon. Due to it's anomalous properties, anyone enter SCP-5179 will turn into SCP-5179-1 and the process is irreversible.

Deleted at -17 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

EthanolC2H5OH

+ show block
– hide block

It's a cool idea albeit executed poorly, there is a lot of typos and grammar errors that need to be addressed and the weird white boxes make the page cluttered and difficult to read as you're constantly switching between the two parts of the article. The whole 'Youth passes as a fleeting river, star lies in the silver flower.' is quite a good addition and the fact it addresses the reader is a brilliant touch. Overall, a good concept executed and worded poorly.

JakdragonX

+ show block
– hide block

I wanted to love this, so, so badly. In truth, I really like this concept, and the disjointed aspect of the white boxes sort of peering into… "someone's (???)" inner life in this town of Astra was fun, albeit a bit off-toned.

However, unfortunately, there's just a massive level of "clutter" that can't be ignored (not even when it comes to the formatting.) The ending is also a bit… flat? Like, I can sort of see what you're attempting with it, but frankly the characters are somewhat baseless that its hard to keep track. It kind of reads like a "trying-to-remember" dream sequence, which may be intentional, but for myself personally it's hard to associate.

I really want to love this, and I see some potential. I'd love to see this rewritten and reworked, since it's just conceptually pleasing for me personally.

EDIT: Should also mention that I like the fourth-wall break (I'm always a sucker for them), but after re-reading, this time it feels entirely off-base from everything else, not to mention gimmicky at best.

SCP-5156 is a sexless,hairless,bipedal humanoid entity measuring 4 meters tall while standing erect. It has very little body mass and very little coloration in its skin, The arms and legs of SCP-5156 is covered of abnormally large cuts and scratches, (of which would be fatal to a human) exposing the entity’s muscular system. The entity has no visible hands or fingers, but it is suspected to have perfectly invisible claws.

Deleted at -15 and three votes. Rewrite by TheAnimateFry pending.

SCP-5127 appears to be a large sword composed of an unknown metal. It was discovered in Serbia, Nis in 2010 after a massive amount of reports of ghostly figure slaughtering people. The object is proven to be indestructible as it appears to regenerate lost material within a few seconds. All attempts to destroy the object have resulted in a massive containment breach of at least 10 SCP's at all times.

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-3178 is seasoning which consists of the composition normally found in factory-made monosodium glutamate with the addition of an unidentified substance. SCP-3178 instances are found consistently 2,700 mg per 4x4cm packets in the 12x16cm packaging of ███████ instant noodles, specifically with the flavour of ███████ brand potato chips. There are no records stating that the respective manufacturing companies have collaborated in the past. At present, the Foundation is in possession of 18,010 instances of SCP-3178.

Deleted at -11 and three votes.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5914 is a soulless and non-corporeal entity that takes the forms of any individuals . While not doing its "job," the subject would take the form of a dark figure that displays an unknown type of dark matter. It is approximately 171 centimeters (cm), or 5 feet and 7.5 inches, with luminescent red eyes5. The entity claims that it exists in a place so-called as "The Barreplex"6 that existed in an unknown multi-dimensional location shows no signs of hostility, is capable of speech and understands all sorts of human languages. However, it has a very disrespectful/vulgar, and immature attitude.

Deleted at -23 and three votes.

SCP-5446 or ‘Alex’ appears to be a teenage ███████████ female aged around 14-17, SCP-5446’s appearance is normal from the neck down, but her face appears to be ‘censored’ within all forms of visual contact, this includes through the naked eye and through any sort of photography or videography.

Deleted at -18 and three votes.

SCP-5311 is an unidentified, partially-sentient “creature” that remains in constant confinement to the interiors of lengths of pipe—almost exclusively the plumbing of residential housing (pre-containment). It’s suspected to have remained dormant in the pipes of an unknown location until its accidental discovery, estimated to have been in ██ of the year 20█.

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Scorpion451

+ show block
– hide block

The core idea here is definitely viable. Classic vanilla killer monsters are hard to pull off, but the anomaly is a good one to carry something like that. Ditch the targeting of people who know about it and the sound-trigger thing; this thing only needs the one party trick. It's a solid one.

I'm just going to do a rough breakdown here, if you take this to the forums for an overhaul and second try (and you should) PM me and I'll do a more in-depth one. I'm being a little blunt here because I think this is a strong idea but it will only work with a total overhaul.

The surface problems are tone breaks and bad formatting - scare italics in the Containment procedures, overdramatic statements of how dangerous it is, directly addressing the reader, hard-to-read paragraph organization… lots of little things that draft critique can help you address.

More than that though, you're totally missing the mark on what makes this thing a good monster, and how to present it. There's a lot here telling us we should be afraid of this thing, and not nearly enough showing us any of it. Tied into that, you also show your cards way, way too early, especially with regard to the strongest parts of this.

For instance, Don't beat us over the head with everything that qualifies as a pipe immediately in the containment procedures. Keep it subtle, just say it has to be kept x meters from tube-like structures or objects, and describe how it moves between pipes and manipulates the flow of things through them. And then let it click into place when the containment team points a gun at it. You can do the same with containment breaches demonstrating the endless series of things which can be considered tubes. There's potential for this thing to be scary as hell, it just needs to be used right.

Fragmented Memory 1289

Hmm. This place looks cozy.

Hey! Who are you? This is a restricted server.

Oh, a new friend! Hi! I'm Cubie. I am new around these parts. What's your name?

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

scp-5587 (The Breathability of Argon) by solius deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5587 is a gateway to an alternate dimension (SCP-5587-A) set into the trunk of an oak tree located on Mount Eisenhower at elevation of 4203 ft in White Mountain National Park, New Hampshire. When an organism comes in contact with SCP-5587, it is pulled through the tree into SCP-5587-A.

Feedback ported:

[+] from FinlandSite_Helsinki
– hide block

This SCP reminds me of the classic first SCPs of the site, more of an informational page than a thrilling story that most SCPs today must have to succeed. I think this is honestly by the book, it has all the detail we need, it’s not necessarily confusing, and it has almost zero grammatical or spelling errors which means the author put some work into making sure this is perfect. While I didn’t find this SCP particularly exciting it’s what the site was built on and feels more like an actual research log than a story that seems more like a tale which is what most current SCPs are like nowadays. Good work though! +1

SCP-5168-2 appears to be the human male Private Mas Philip moulded with a carbon fibre-like material. Now labelled SCP-5168-1. SCP-5168-2 is 187m tall just as Private Maz was. Private Mas Philip was a former member of MTF Nu-7 ”Hammer Down” infantry force.

scp-5057 (The Secret Ingredient Is Mayo) by YummyBees deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5057 is a ██████████ brand chocolate cake. Anomalous effects occur when a subject makes contact with the cake. The subject will be instantly transported to a child's birthday party in an alternate world, however, details vary between reports.

Feedback ported:

[+] from Quicksilvers
– hide block

+1 from me, simple and strange! Just a few things could be fixed up, though!

(he shifts nervously in his seat)

Usually when subjects do an action during an interview/recorded file, its italicized and is its own line. Here's an example from 4018:

PoI-4018-0: I know how easy it is to pretend that the old pretenses and euphemisms still hold up, and that people take the easy route when confronting things head on is hard. So I'm sorry for making things that much harder to cope with. But really, you know I had to do it to them.

PoI-4018-0 tosses a lit lighter onto the ground, igniting the gasoline. The fire spreads towards the recruitment center; shortly after it reaches the interior, the building goes up in flames.

PoI-4018-0: If I'm pissing you off, or…

Also, the other thing is this sentence:

The subject will be instantly transported to an alternate world which varies between subjects, however it is always a child's birthday party and a ██████████ chocolate cake is always being served.

"…it is always a child's birthday party" doesn't really fit the rest of the sentence (weird syntax) and maybe should be rewritten or reworded. The dialogue in the interview also seems a little stiff.

Sorry if I dumped a little too much crit - I just like the idea and it needs a little tweaking for it to shine more!

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5306 is a Artificial Christmas Tree, previously manufactured and owned by the brand Macy’s, is fully decorated with Christmas ornaments, and is indistinguishable from a non-anomalous Artificial Christmas Tree. But, unlike a non-anomalous Christmas tree, object seems impervious to any type of hazard, such as heat. It is unknown if object is sentient, but all signs point to no.

Deleted at -15 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Scorpion451

+ show block
– hide block

It's not a terrible idea at the core, but there are a lot of spelling, grammar, and formatting issues here, and more importantly it doesn't go beyond just being a list of things and their traits.

I'd strongly suggest taking this through the greenlight and critique process, there's a salvageable idea here.
